title: Recent rainfall predicts week-long richness elevation and species-selective reassembly in active frog communities
description: Reproducibility package for a Journal of Animal Ecology Research Article testing the duration and compositional structure of rainfall-associated change in acoustically active frog communities. The archive contains the anonymized manuscript, frozen analysis contracts, result receipts, deterministic figures and analysis code. Raw third-party datasets are not redistributed.
